name: Max strict pull-ups
protocol: One max-effort set from a dead hang, chin over the bar and full lockout each rep, no kipping; this is a max test, so go until form breaks. Warm up first and rest 3 min after.

name: Max band-assisted pull-ups
protocol: Only if pull-up-max is 0: one max-effort set of strict band-assisted pull-ups, logging the band used; go until form breaks. Rest 3 min before the next test.

name: Max full push-ups
protocol: One max-effort set, chest to fist height, body in one straight line, full lockout; this is a max test, so go until form breaks. Rest 3 min after.

name: Max incline push-ups
protocol: Only if push-up-max is under 3: one max-effort set of strict incline push-ups, logging the incline height; go until form breaks. Rest 3 min after.

name: Max dips
protocol: One max-effort set on the dip station, shoulders to elbow height and full lockout, no kicking; go until form breaks. Rest 3 min after.

name: Dip support hold
protocol: Only if dip-max is 0: hold the top support with locked elbows and shoulders pressed down as long as form holds; this is a max effort. Best of 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: Chest-to-wall handstand hold
protocol: After wrist prep, walk into a chest-to-wall handstand and hold with straight arms, ribs down and shoulders open until form breaks; this is a max effort. Best of 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: L-sit hold
protocol: On the dip-station handles, hold a full L-sit with straight legs at hip height and shoulders pressed down until form breaks; this is a max effort. Best of 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: Tuck L-sit hold
protocol: Only if l-sit-hold is under 5 s: hold a tuck L-sit on the dip-station handles until form breaks; this is a max effort. Best of 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: Pistol squat, left leg
protocol: Pass is one controlled full-depth pistol on the left leg with the heel down; log the assistance level used (none, TRX, or box height) whether pass or fail. Up to 3 attempts, 1 min rest between.

name: Pistol squat, right leg
protocol: Pass is one controlled full-depth pistol on the right leg with the heel down; log the assistance level used (none, TRX, or box height) whether pass or fail. Up to 3 attempts, 1 min rest between.

name: Hollow hold
protocol: Hold a hollow body with lower back pressed to the floor, arms overhead and legs low, until the back lifts; this is a max effort. Best of 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: Max hanging leg raises
protocol: One max-effort set of straight-leg raises to hip height or above from an active hang, no swinging; go until form breaks. Rest 2 min after.

name: Front split, left leg forward
protocol: After a warm-up, sink into a square-hipped front split with the left leg forward and measure the gap from the floor to the front of the pelvis; work at a strong stretch, not pain. Best of 2 attempts, 1 min between.

name: Front split, right leg forward
protocol: After a warm-up, sink into a square-hipped front split with the right leg forward and measure the gap from the floor to the front of the pelvis; work at a strong stretch, not pain. Best of 2 attempts, 1 min between.

name: Middle split
protocol: After a warm-up, slide into a middle split with knees pointing up and measure the gap from the floor to the pelvis; work at a strong stretch, not pain. Best of 2 attempts, 1 min between.

name: Pancake chest to floor
protocol: Seated with legs wide and knees up, fold forward from the hips with a long spine and measure the gap from the floor to the chest; work at a strong stretch, not pain. Best of 2 attempts, 1 min between.

name: Bridge
protocol: Pass is a 10 s hold with straight arms in the hardest variant achieved (table top, wall walk-down, full bridge or handstand to bridge); log the variant name. Up to 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: Planche lean hold
protocol: After wrist prep, hold a planche lean with locked elbows, protracted shoulders and the shoulders ahead of the hands, logging the lean depth, until form breaks; this is a max effort. Best of 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: Tuck front lever hold
protocol: Hold a tuck front lever with straight arms and hips level with the shoulders until form breaks; this is a max effort. Best of 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: German hang hold
protocol: Enter the German hang slowly from a tuck and hold at a comfortable shoulder stretch until form or comfort breaks, then exit the way you came; max effort but never into pain. Best of 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: Max elevated pike push-ups
protocol: One max-effort set with feet on the box, hips over the shoulders, head to the floor and full lockout, logging the box height; go until form breaks. Rest 3 min after.

name: Max chest-to-bar pull-ups
protocol: One max-effort set from a dead hang where the chest touches the bar each rep, no kipping; go until form breaks. Rest 3 min after.

name: Skin the cat
protocol: Pass is one comfortable, controlled skin the cat into German hang and back with no pain or jerking. Up to 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.

name: Max archer pull-ups
protocol: One max-effort set per side with the assisting arm straight, rest 3 min between sides, and log the lower of the two; go until form breaks.

name: Dragon flag negative
protocol: Pass is one full dragon flag negative lowered under control over 3-5 s with a straight body and no hip pike. Up to 2 attempts, 2 min rest between.
